## Requirement interface

A signable approval / authorization requirement. `sign()` returns the matching [RequirementSignature](./morpho-sdk.requirementsignature.md)<!-- -->; `action` describes the requirement without signing.

Generic over the signature it produces so permit encoders narrow to [PermitRequirementSignature](./morpho-sdk.permitrequirementsignature.md) and the authorization encoder to [AuthorizationRequirementSignature](./morpho-sdk.authorizationrequirementsignature.md)<!-- -->; the two-parameter form is kept for Midnight action requirements that are parameterized by action and args.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface Requirement<TSignatureOrAction extends RequirementSignature | SignatureRequirementAction = RequirementSignature, TArgs extends RequirementSignatureArgs | undefined = undefined>
```
